lines.atom1: Everything is made of atoms: a positive nucleus, and tiny negative electrons.
lines.atom2: The outermost electrons are only loosely held.
lines.metal1: In a metal, outer electrons break free, and wander in every direction.
lines.metal2: But random wandering means no net flow, so no electricity yet.
lines.circuit1: A battery pushes the electrons the same way. That steady flow is a current.
lines.circuit2: Voltage is the push. Current is the flow. And resistance is what slows it down.
lines.outro: Electricity is the flow of electric charge.
